plain: Farming, including growing crops and raising animals.

webster.text: The business of a farmer, comprehending agriculture or tillage of the ground, the raising, managing and fattening of cattle and other domestic animals, the management of the dairy and whatever the land produces.

example.quote: We have therefore liberally furnished them with the implements of husbandry and household use; we have placed among them instructors in the arts of first necessity; and they are covered with the aegis of the law against aggressors from among ourselves.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Second Inaugural Address, Mar. 4, 1805
